metadata.purpose: Publish a grouped Observable once per new key; route each subsequent input to its keyed Subject; preserve upstream while an emitted child remains subscribed.

cardinality.signature: groupBy(key:T!→K!) : T* -> GroupedObservable<K,T>*; each group: T*
conditions: Outer next cardinality equals distinct keys seen by the key selector under Map SameValueZero identity while outer is subscribed.
Every source next causes one key selector invocation and one Subject.next for that key, including the first value after group creation.
Group and outer completion/error are separate notifications with group-first ordering; cancellation is not completion.

scope.parameters: key selector only; identity elements, default Subject connector, no group duration; keys use JS Map SameValueZero.
scope.callbacks: One synchronous key selector outcome per source value, supplied externally; pure model never executes application logic.
scope.time: No timer/scheduler. Keys are assigned in source arrival order. A new group is announced before its first Subject.next.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant key callback; grouped subscribers can attach between modeled source notifications. At most one active subscriber per group.
exclusions: Optional element, duration and custom connector profiles, including duration-driven group closure and reuse.
Multiple simultaneous subscribers per group; subscription inside the very same source-next action word is represented by ordered effects, not a nested model microstep.
User callback/observer reentrancy, throwing group subscribers and group subscriptions after terminal teardown.

initialization.sourceSubscription: One upstream source connects only when the outer result is subscribed.

ownership.sharing: The original source is shared between grouped Subject consumers by this operator instance; output groups themselves are live multicast Subjects.
ownership.reset: New result subscription creates a new group registry and source lease. Orphaned outer subscription retains upstream only for active children.

resources.owner: one correlated key-selection call per source.next
per-key Subject subscription owned by grouped consumers

dispatch.actionSemantics: On a new key notify the outer observer about the GroupToken BEFORE the new Subject is fed its first opaque value. Target group:<n> is the Subject, not the outer observer. Group child subscriber leases delay source teardown.
cancellationCheckpoints: After a resolved key selection/Subject delivery; cancel outer silently, retain the source for subscribed children.
